label: early trigram [1/z/j/w] j [w/u/y/f/q/z] in the original phase
explanation: Sparse feature (about 0.01% of steps). Its core is a trigram near the start of the sequence: the input is one of w/u/y/f/q/z, the previous input is j, and the token before that is 1, z, j or w, at t=2 or 3 during the original phase (for example z j [q], 1 j [w], v 1 j [u]). That core holds about 51% of activation mass, with precision about 0.43 (dev). The same trigram later in the original sequence or during the copy phase mostly does not fire. Activations are fairly uniform (about 0.5-0.6 of max). The other half of the mass is scattered and has no simple structure: weak firing on <DEL> and on the first copy step, often in sequences that start with w, plus isolated original-phase steps. The rare top activations (0.8-1.0 of max) mostly fall in this scattered set, so the core trigram does not cover the top magnitudes. The feature never fires at t=0 or t=1, or at recall_idx >= 2.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=j (+6.08), t=3 & prev_tok=j (+3.56), prev2_tok=z (+3.33), orig0=w (+3.31), prev2_tok=j (+2.97), prev2_tok=1 (+2.89). Lower it: phase=2 (-4.01), phase=0 (-2.11), in_first=0 (-0.39).
